bagPolicy.summary: Security inspects all bags. A personal item up to 17 × 13 × 8 inches is recommended; bags that cannot fit on your lap or under your seat must go to the $2 coat check.
allowed: Bag fitting on a lap or under a seat
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre does not own parking; it recommends Loop Auto Parks at 524 South Wabash Avenue and also lists Grant Park South and Printers Square garages.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Auditorium Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Accessible concession and merchandise counters operate in the main-floor lobby. Outside food and drinks are prohibited, and purchases at the theatre require a card.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Use the step-free ramp entrance just west of the main glass entrance near Ida B. Wells Drive and Wabash Avenue. Accessible seats are in the front orchestra; accessible restrooms and an elevator are available.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theatre’s published FAQ does not state a specific re-entry rule for guests who leave the building.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect will-call tickets at the box office window on the east side of the foyer as you enter. On performance days, the box office opens two hours before showtime.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors open one hour before event start. Security screening can include metal detectors and handheld wands; late seating is restricted for select concerts.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
